title: Space before at a page top opened by the paragraph's own break, compat 15: a pageBreakBefore paragraph drops it (direct or styled, also after an after=400 neighbour), a paragraph led by its own w:br keeps it, a break-only paragraph before it drops it
source: probe build.py -> Word for Mac direct PDF (2026-11-02), pymupdf span tops, Letter, Calibri 11 after=0 line=240, 14pt headings before=400 after=200; page 1 A1 71.95, flush lead 72.19, kept lead 92.11 (+20), compat 14 after=200 -> 82.27; compat 15

cases.note: B1: direct pageBreakBefore + before=400 after a plain paragraph
C1: leading w:br page in the paragraph keeps its before in every mode; gen cuts the line and drops it
E1: after a break-only paragraph the before is dropped
G1: pageBreakBefore before=400 after an after=400 paragraph: nothing beyond the merged spacing
H1: pageBreakBefore from the paragraph style
